RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, March 7, 2018/Phalguna 16, 1939 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Skill Development and Entrepreneurship; Steel;
Tourism; Y outh Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 15
42
Steps to define and curb hate speech
*121. SHRI VIVEK GUPTA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of steps taken by
Government on the recommendations of  the
Report No. 267 of  the Law Commission of
India with regard to amending the IPC and
Cr PC for incorporating provisions to define
and curb hate speech; and
(b) the State-wise details of  the number
of cases reported under the IPC that fall
under the broader category of  'hate speech'
reported during the last three years, with a
special emphasis on cases in which
rumours, hate speech insinuations
perpetrated through social media and
WhatsApp led to attack on minority
community and mob lynching?
Unrest in Barak valley, Assam
*122. SHRI SANTIUSE KUJUR: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of  the
recent ongoing unrest in the Barak valley
in Assam caused by various groups;
(b) whether any action has been taken
by Government to ease out the situation in
Assam; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Taking over of  Waqf properties under
Enemy Property Act
*123. SHRI HUSAIN DALWAI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has the power
to take over Waqf properties and use them
for other purposes under the Enemy
Property Act, 1968;
(b) if so, State-wise details of number
of Waqf properties taken over by
Government along with the purpose for
which these properties are currently being
used for;

43
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) the details of identified enemy
properties in Maharashtra and the purpose
for which these properties are currently
being used; and
(d) the State-wise details of cases where
the identification and confiscation of the
enemy property has been challenged by the
owners or current occupants?
Increase in unemployment as per the
report of ILO
*124. SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether as per the recent report of
International Labour Organisation (ILO),
unemployment in India is likely to increase
in 2018 and 2019;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of target set by
Government to generate employment
during the years 2017-18 and 2018-19,
sector-wise;
(d) the details of target achieved during
2017-18, sector-wise along with the source
of data for employment generation; and
(e) the reasons for failure of
Government in employment generation?
Development of NE under BADP
*125. SHRI MAHESH PODDAR: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the steps Government has taken so
far for the development of North-Eastern
Region under the Border Area
Development Programme (BADP); and
(b) the details of the budget allocated
during the last three years for the
development of North-Eastern Region?
Cess collected under the Building and
Other Construction Workers' Act,
1996
†*126. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the amount collected by
Government till December, 2017 by
imposing cess after enactments of the
Building and Other Construction Workers'
(Regulation of Employment and
Conditions of Service) Act, 1996;
(b) the total amount spent so far out of
the above and the amount spent on welfare
of construction workers;
(c) whether the Supreme Court had
ordered to spend the amount collected from
the cess only on welfare of construction
workers; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and to what
extent the direction has been complied
with?
Merger of Public Sector oil companies
*127. DR. SANJAY SINH: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
merge all Public Sector oil companies into
a single entity;
(b) if so, the details of the merger
proposal; and
(c) the reasons behind merger of major
oil companies into one entity?

44
Honour killings
*128. SHRI PARTAP SINGH BAJWA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether honour killings and
harassment of married couples are on the
rise in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the total
number of such cases reported along with
the accused arrested and the action taken
against the guilty persons during each of
the last three years and the current year,
State-wise;
(c) whether Government has constituted
any Committee to examine the issue
relating to honour killings; and
(d) if so, the recommendations made by
such Committee and the steps taken by
Government thereon?
Deficiency of fire fighting
infrastructure
